sentences.en: I explained it to him, only to make him confused.
sentences.zh: 我向他解释了这件事，结果却让他更糊涂了。

sentences.en: They confused the names of the sender and the addressee.
sentences.zh: 他们把发件人和收件人的名字搞混了。

sentences.en: Confused by her careless mistake, she burst into tears.
sentences.zh: 由于她的粗心大意，她感到困惑不已，哭了起来。
